description: 二手车需求、车源与线下看车撮合 UI

chat.buyerTitleEn: Tell us what car you need.
buyerHeadlines: 让预算遇见合适的车况。
buyerHeadlinesEn: Tell us what car you need.
Put your budget next to real vehicle condition.
sellerHeadlines: 让好车被真正需要的人看见。
sellerHeadlinesEn: Let the right buyers find a good car.
Put the vehicle condition to work.
chat.buyerDescription: 告诉我们预算、用途、时间和不能妥协的条件，平台会把需求交给合适的车源。
chat.buyerDescriptionEn: Share your budget, use case, timing, and non-negotiables. The platform routes the need to suitable vehicles.
chat.sellerDescription: 填写车源资料和报价，审核通过后进入买家匹配。
chat.sellerDescriptionEn: Add the vehicle details and price. Approved offers enter buyer matching.
chat.buyerPlaceholder: 例如：预算、用途、时间和不能妥协的条件……
chat.buyerPlaceholderEn: For example: budget, use case, timing, and the conditions you will not compromise on…
chat.sellerPlaceholder: 例如：车型、车况、价格和看车地点……
chat.sellerPlaceholderEn: For example: model, condition, price, and viewing location…
chat.buyerFootnote: 联系方式只在双方同意后交换；线下看车会保留撮合记录。
chat.buyerFootnoteEn: Contact details are exchanged only after both sides agree; offline viewings remain in the matching record.
chat.sellerFootnote: 资料审核通过后才会展示；联系方式只在双方同意后交换。
chat.sellerFootnoteEn: Approved details are the only ones shown; contact details are exchanged only after both sides agree.
